correction_record.what_was_wrong: Record version 1 assigned d2_enumeration_candidate NO to pages 013-082, 013-084 and 013-085 on the grounds that the printed declination lay outside the sealed B1 window by roughly 24 arcminutes, which was argued to exceed any plausible B1950 to J2000 shift.
correction_record.why_that_was_wrong: That argument is a new decision heuristic invented during the pass. The sealed B1 text requires the printed value to pass through the WOW v1 epoch tool with the conversion recorded per record. A margin that feels large enough is not a sealed decision rule, and admitting one would be precisely the shortcut the chain exists to prevent.
correction_record.correction_applied: Those three pages are now UNRESOLVED_EPOCH_TRANSFORM_REQUIRED. No page receives a formal declination decision until the already established v1 transform has actually been run.
correction_record.who_caught_it: Controller review, 2026-08-18. The analyst proposed the heuristic; the controller rejected it. Recorded plainly, in keeping with the WOW v1 detection-provenance discipline.
correction_record.generalised_rule_added: A quantity in one epoch is never compared with a bound in another epoch by arguing that the gap is comfortably large. Either the declared transform is run and recorded, or the state stays UNRESOLVED.

structural_page_selection_method.role_limit: NOT a complete header detector. It may be used to propose pages worth classifying and may NEVER be used to assert that all header pages have been found.
structural_page_selection_method.description: Header pages carry a mostly blank body and are therefore materially smaller than data pages. Candidates were identified from the file sizes published in the Apache directory listing, threshold below 80 percent of the median page size, before any page was opened.
structural_page_selection_method.why_this_is_content_free: File size is directory metadata. No image was decoded to make the selection.
structural_page_selection_method.observed_precision: Of the flagged pages opened, 001, 072, 084, 088, 143, 237, 412 and 456 were HEADER_PAGE instances; 071, 083, 090, 142, 411 and 455 were DATA_PAGE instances. The locator over-selects.
structural_page_selection_method.observed_recall: UNKNOWN. Whether any header page falls above the size threshold has not been tested. Establishing completeness would require an exhaustive class pass over the folder.

finding_1_three_distinct_declination_qua.observation: Three different declination quantities are in play and they do not agree. (a) The page header prints a DECLINATION SETTING, for example -25 20. (b) The data table prints a per-row DECLIN. column with epoch stated as 1950.0, for example -26 13 on the same page. (c) The publisher states elsewhere that the true declination observed for the adjacent continuum record was -27 00.
finding_1_three_distinct_declination_qua.magnitude: The header setting and the printed row value differ by roughly 50 arcminutes on the pages examined.
finding_1_three_distinct_declination_qua.which_one_the_sealed_bound_governs: Sealed B4 names the declination of observation AS PRINTED ON THE RECORD, which is the per-row DECLIN. column captured by R2. The header setting is preserved as a separate instrument variable and is never used to decide eligibility.
finding_1_three_distinct_declination_qua.unresolved: Why setting and printed row value differ, and how either relates to the true declination observed, is UNKNOWN and is not resolved here.
finding_1_three_distinct_declination_qua.why_it_matters_beyond_this_pass: A single apparently simple variable turned out to be at least three semantically distinct quantities. A summary that recorded declination equals X would have destroyed that distinction without leaving a trace.
finding_1_three_distinct_declination_qua.no_reconciliation_attempted: Reconciling them would require material outside the permitted enumeration fields.

finding_2_epoch_barrier_blocks_final_dec.observation: The archive prints declination with epoch 1950.0. The sealed B1 window derives from the WOW v1 sealed J2000 declination.
finding_2_epoch_barrier_blocks_final_dec.consequence: No printed value may be compared with the sealed window until it passes through the WOW v1 epoch tool, with the conversion recorded per record.
finding_2_epoch_barrier_blocks_final_dec.state_of_all_pages: Declination eligibility is UNRESOLVED_EPOCH_TRANSFORM_REQUIRED for every page examined, without exception.
finding_2_epoch_barrier_blocks_final_dec.no_margin_exception: There is no margin large enough to bypass this. See correction_record.
finding_2_epoch_barrier_blocks_final_dec.how_it_will_be_resolved: By running 042_wow/scripts/wow2_epoch.py unmodified on the printed values and recording its declared provenance string with each converted value. No new transform is written.

epoch_transform_work_order.modification: NONE. The tool is used exactly as sealed in WOW v1.
epoch_transform_work_order.why_the_analyst_cannot_run_it: The tool requires astropy and numpy, which are present in the owner's venv_gpu environment and absent from the analyst's working environment. Reimplementing the transform elsewhere would be a new method and is therefore refused.
required_runs: First: the tool's own selftest, so that the transform is validated against the sealed OR-20 to OR-21 conversion in this session before any value is converted.

Then: one conversion per distinct printed declination value encountered. For this pass that is the single value -26 13 in epoch 1950.0. Right ascension is required as an input by the tool; the printed RT. ASCEN. (1950.0) value of the corresponding row is used and is recorded as an enumeration input rather than as a comparison variable.
epoch_transform_work_order.recording_requirement: The provenance string the tool prints, naming the astropy and numpy versions and the FK4 to FK5 frames, is recorded verbatim alongside every converted value.
epoch_transform_work_order.decision_rule_after_conversion: The converted J2000 declination is compared against the sealed B1 window of -27 17 to -26 37. Only then may a page move from UNRESOLVED_EPOCH_TRANSFORM_REQUIRED to YES or NO.
